title: Nine Lines and No Marks
subtitle: 问答与回应 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 问答与回应（生活与学习·问题与解答）
meta: 主题语境：问答与回应（生活与学习·问题与解答）　|　核心词汇：answer　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 answer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my mother wrote an ① answer in an exam that was nine lines long and got no marks, and she kept the paper for thirty-one years without ever saying what the question was. She said ② the answer to a question is not the same as the answer to the person who asked it, and I understood that in 1991 and not before; an answer, she said, is the only thing you can be right about and still lose.

There was ③ an answer to the letter in 1968, and it came nine months late and said nothing, and my grandmother called it the true answer. She wrote ④ in answer to the council four times and got four letters back, none of which answered anything, and she said correspondence is a machine for producing paper; every answer, she said, is late or it is not an answer.

The ⑤ answer in the back of the book, meaning the printed one, was wrong, and my uncle said a wrong answer in print is the only kind anybody believes. My father said ⑥ the answer is no, meaning the job, and my mother said he had answered a question nobody had asked; an answer, she said, is a thing you give whether or not it was wanted.

In 1979 my teacher said the ⑦ answer to the whole problem was nine, and we wrote it down, and she said that was the only lesson in which everybody had been right. There was ⑧ no easy answer to the shop, my father said in 1984, and my grandmother said there had never been an easy question about it either; an answer, she said, is what you call the thing you decided.

The ⑨ answer I would give now, if I were asked, is the nine lines in 1966, which got no marks and which she never threw away. An ⑩ answer, she told me in 1996, is the only thing in a life that can be right for thirty-one years before anybody asks the question; ours was, and the question has still never been asked, and the answer was nine lines.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: D. n. 解决办法；应对之道
E. 固定搭配：an answer to ... ……的答复／答案
F. 固定搭配：in answer to ... 作为对……的答复
G. 固定搭配：the answer to a question 问题的答案
H. 固定搭配：there is no easy answer 没有简单的答案

items.q: wrote an answer in an exam
the answer to a question is not the same
an answer to the letter in 1968
in answer to the council four times
The answer in the back of the book
the answer is no, meaning the job
the answer to the whole problem
no easy answer to the shop
The answer I would give now
An answer, she told me in 1996

answers.why: answer 意为“回答、答复”，1966 年母亲在一场考试里写了九行回答，没得分，却把卷子留了三十一年。
the answer to a question 意为“问题的答案”，她说一个问题的答案不等于提问者的答案。
an answer to ... 意为“……的答复”，1968 年那封信终于有了答复，晚了九个月，什么也没说。
in answer to ... 意为“作为对……的答复”，她四次写信答复议会，收回四封信。
answer 意为“答案、解答”，书后面印的那个答案是错的，而印错的答案偏偏是人人信的。
answer 意为“回应、应答”，父亲说“回答是不”，指的是那份工作，而母亲说他回答了一个没人问过的问题。
answer 意为“解决办法、应对之道”，1979 年老师说整道题的解法就是九。
there is no easy answer 意为“没有简单的答案”，1984 年父亲说铺子的事没有简单的答案。
answer 意为“回答”，若有人问我，我现在要给出的回答就是 1966 年那九行。
answer 意为“答案”，她说答案是一生中唯一可以在被人问起之前就对了三十一年的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年母亲在一场考试里写了一则九行的回答，没得分，她把卷子留了三十一年。（answer）
她说，一个问题的答案，并不等于提问的人想要的答案。（the answer to a question）
1968 年那封信终于有了答复，晚了九个月，却什么也没说。（an answer to）
她四次写信答复议会，收回四封信，哪一封也没有回答任何问题。（in answer to）
1979 年老师说，整道题的解法就是九。（answer to）
1984 年父亲说，铺子的事没有简单的答案。（no easy answer）
answers: In 1966 my mother wrote an answer in an exam that was nine lines long and got no marks.
She said the answer to a question is not the same as the answer to the person who asked it.
There was an answer to the letter in 1968, and it came nine months late and said nothing.
She wrote in answer to the council four times and got four letters back.
In 1979 my teacher said the answer to the whole problem was nine.
My father said in 1984 that there was no easy answer to the shop.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 answer 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 my mother wrote an answer in an exam that was nine lines long and got no marks.
She said the answer to a question is not the same as the answer to the person who asked it.
There was an answer to the letter in 1968, and she wrote in answer to the council four times.
The answer in the back of the book was wrong, and my father said the answer is no, meaning the job.
In 1979 my teacher said the answer to the whole problem was nine, and everybody was right.
An answer, she told me in 1996, can be right for thirty-one years before anybody asks the question.
